diagnostic_a.semantics: R2.16 diagnostic A carried the pre-refinement/partial cell timer semantics; the metric did not cover the full value lookup and serialization boundary used in validation B.

validation_b.semantics: Validation B measured full cell processing from before relationship/semantic/entity lookup through cell rendering; serialization itself was separately measured and negligible.

r2_17_contract.cell_value_lookup_elapsed_ms: value source identification and governed lookup before serialization
r2_17_contract.csv_cell_serialization_elapsed_ms: legacy-compatible name for cell normalization/render time
r2_17_contract.column_cost_summary: bounded per-column aggregate generated generically from contract columns
